name: expand-toolbar
title: Expand Toolbar
description: Icon buttons where the picked one grows to show its name while its neighbours slide aside to make room.

perf.budget: One shared value per button; two widths animate on a change, so the row lays out for the length of the spring. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: Measured with its own script that taps each tool in turn, since the default gestures miss the toolbar.

a11y.reducedMotion: The picked button shows its label at once, without growing.
a11y.screenReader: A toolbar of buttons named by their labels, the picked one marked as selected.
a11y.touchTarget: Every button is at least 44 pt square.
